answer: Brilliant Lode (GSQ site 38722): what might remain today, from official services and registers checked on 2026-11-23; each record carries its source, the query URL and the check time. Exploration: 14 mineral boreholes within 2 km listed (nearest CHARTERS TOWERS NS38 at 0 m, GEOLOGICAL SURVEY OF QUEENSLAND; no drill dates recorded); 7 MINOCC-linked company reports listed (latest: CR 28518 "EPM 8150 8563 8564 MDL 115 116 118 119 CHARTERS TOWERS GOLD PROJECT COMBINED ANNUAL REPORT FOR PERIOD ENDING 31/1/1996", 1996). Resources: 6 records, each a modern reported resource (JORC/as published), not historical production and not a claim about what remains: Charters Towers / Charters Towers (Project) Gold as at 2020-12-09 (JORC code 2012): probable reserve 2.5 Mt at 7.7 g/t, about 618,902 troy ounces contained (derived); indicated resource 3.2 Mt at 7.7 g/t, about 792,194 troy ounces contained (derived); inferred resource 32 Mt at 14 g/t, about 14,403,534 troy ounces contained (derived) | Charters Towers / Charters Towers (Underground) Gold as at 2003-06-30 (JORC code): probable reserve 126 kt at 6.6 g/t, about 26,737 troy ounces contained (derived); indicated resource 224 kt at 7.5 g/t, about 54,013 troy ounces contained (derived) | Charters Towers / Charters Towers (Open Pit) Gold as at 2003-06-30 (JORC code): indicated resource 95 kt at 3.6 g/t, about 10,996 troy ounces contained (derived) | Charters Towers / Charters Towers (Tailings) Gold as at 1998-06-30 (JORC code): measured resource 145 kt at 2.4 g/t, about 11,188 troy ounces contained (derived). Access: nearest town Charters Towers (0.9 km, population 8234); nearest major road YORK STREET A6 (0.2 km; national or state highway, sealed); nearest operational power line Charters Towers to Cape River East 66 kV (1.6 km); straight-line distance, not route distance. Environment: 5 environmental authorities listed (2 over the site point, for example EPML00556713 CITIGOLD CORPORATION LIMITED, suspended; EPSX00599613 CITIGOLD CORPORATION LIMITED, granted); 4 abandoned-mines records (program site RED AND WHITE DUMPS PS0059, Priority), 3 of them tailings; 458 recorded mine openings within 2 km. Not found or not checked: environment: contaminated-land and environmental-management registers: no keyless official spatial layer was found among the Queensland map services (layer names searched 2026-11-23), so they are not checked. Note: exploration: 14 mineral boreholes within 2 km; 0 with a rig-release date, 14 without; operators named: GEOLOGICAL SURVEY OF QUEENSLAND, AUSTRALIAN OIL AND GAS CORPORATION LIMITED, CITIGOLD CORPORATION LIMITED, HOMESTAKE GOLD LIMITED; exploration: MINOCC links 7 company reports to this site; 7 found in the GSQ report index with a title and year, 0 not (the index holds open-file reports with a mapped extent only); resources: Merriland (ENO 333457, 0.1 km, location accuracy 999 m); Charters Towers (ENO 334170, 0.4 km, location accuracy 2000 m); 23 resource records across all reporting dates, the latest per zone and commodity listed (6); earlier reporting dates are not listed. These records show what has been drilled, reported, mapped or registered near the site. They are not an estimate of gold remaining and say nothing about whether any deposit is economic; that needs a geologist. Modern reported resources are kept apart from historical production.

remaining_caveat: These records show what has been drilled, reported, mapped or registered near the site. They are not an estimate of gold remaining and say nothing about whether any deposit is economic; that needs a geologist. Modern reported resources are kept apart from historical production.

caveats.exploration: A borehole or company report near the site is evidence that exploration took place, not of what it found: no assay or result is given here. Boreholes are those on the Geological Survey of Queensland mineral boreholes layer; many have no drill date recorded.
caveats.resources: Each figure is modern reported resource (JORC/as published), not historical production and not a claim about what remains. Tonnes, grade and category are as published by Geoscience Australia from company reports; contained metal is derived here as tonnes times grade and is not a published figure.
caveats.access: All distances are straight-line distance, not route distance; they say nothing about road condition, legal access or the cost of connecting power.
caveats.environment: A register or abandoned-mines record is not an assessment of liability, contamination or rehabilitation cost. Contaminated-land and environmental-management registers were not available as keyless spatial layers and are not checked.
